method: Direct visual and textual inspection of fifteen consecutive item bodies in the user-supplied Kehot publisher scan. OCR was used only for navigation and checked against rendered pages; no blocked crawler was used.
identity_relation: Two identities (ד׳תקפב, ד׳תקצג) were established directly from their item bodies; the remaining thirteen locator-only identities were enriched in place.

evidence_family_dedup.counting_rule: The letters are separate response documents in one controversy and are not treated as independent proof of repeated technical or halachic assertions.
References to the same emissary journey and visits are linked as one event family; each letter supports only its own response and local follow-up.
The emissary visit is event-linked to the tour family, while the Manchester mikveh description remains a separate local situation and is not merged with other mikveh projects.

blocked_alternatives.source: scripts/acquire_source_content.py and the previously blocked GitHub-hosted candidate path
blocked_alternatives.result: Latest acquisition report is no_candidates with attempted=0; the known HTTP 403 crawler route was not retried.
blocked_alternatives.fallback: Used the authorized user-supplied Kehot publisher scan.

verification_scope: Fifteen letter bodies were inspected across PDF pages 353-370. Incoming correspondence, cited works, ship logs, engineering and legal records, institutional reports, medical records, building plans and later outcomes were not independently inspected.
rights_note: Only bounded non-verbatim research paraphrases and locators were recorded; no protected letter was copied in full.
quality_note: All propositions are source-grounded paraphrases. Editorial revision/completion, handwritten-note status, secretary signatures, fragments, medical and halachic limits, and shared Evidence Families are preserved.
